name: RecreationGovAvailability
what_it_holds: Browser-console JavaScript tool (not a stored dataset) that queries the public Recreation.gov API for campsite availability at any campground ID (covers national and state park campgrounds bookable via Recreation.gov) and visualizes open dates per campsite; 16 commits, no license stated.
why_useful: Working, documented method to pull real-time camping-demand/availability signal (a leading indicator of outdoor-recreation/park demand) from a sanctioned public government API (recreation.gov), which could be adapted into a periodic pull for a national-park/state-park camping-occupancy proxy series -- currently we hold no camping-occupancy data.
geography: US, all Recreation.gov-bookable campgrounds (national + state parks)
size_hint: small script repo, no stored data
last_activity: unknown (repo shows 16 commits, date not surfaced)
